title: Hourou Musuko Specials
justification: AniList 10935 (SPECIAL, 2 episode(s) from 2011-08-24 to 2011-09-21) is AniDB 7949's special(s) S1-S2 'Episode 10: Black Sheep' and 'Episode 11: Confession: Each Season', aired 2011-08-24 and 2011-09-21, and AniDB lists MAL 10935 on AniDB 7949. They land on TVDB 221281 0x1 'They Only Laughed at Me ~Black Sheep~' and 0x2 'Confession ~Each Season~', on the same two dates.
